items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Mitch Miller may have done the initial record

ctx.x: That was only on the recording?
Tommy Mace was playing. Tommy Mace was playing oboe. I think he made some of the records. I think Mitch Miller may have done the initial record – LP, as they were called.
How was that, working with strings?
